site_name: Development Site Of 110 100 And Lookers Volkswagon Car Park
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The parts of the development subject to full planning permission shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of the original planning permission ref. 2017/0745 (05/12/2019).
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved drawings as follows:  

CNDL-FLA-ZZ-B1-DR-A-05-009 (Rev P02) - General Arrangement Proposed Plan Basement
CNDL-FLA-ZZ-00-DR-A-05-010 (Rev P02) - General Arrangement Proposed Plan Level 00
CNDL-FLA-ZZ-01-DR-A-05-011 (Rev P03) - General Arrangement Proposed Plan Level 01
CNDL-FLA-ZZ-02-DR-A-05-012 (Rev P03) - General Arrangement Proposed Plan Level 02

CNDL-FLA-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-05-032 (Rev P02) - General Arrangement Proposed South Elevation
CNDL-FLA-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-05-033 (Rev P02) - General Arrangement Proposed West Elevation
CNDL-FLA-04-XX-DR-A-05-101 (Rev P02) - General Arrangement Proposed - Typical Floor Plan 1 - L01 to L04 and L09 to L12

Condition : 3 - i. The non-residential floorspace within buildings 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 as shown on drawings CNDL-FLA-ZZ-00-DR-A-05-010 (Rev P02) and CNDL-FLA-ZZ-01-DR-A-05-011 (Rev P03) shall be used for Commercial, Business & Service (Class E) (excluding Class E(f)) uses only.

ii. The six single storey 'retail' pods on drawing CNDL-FLA-ZZ-00-DR-A-05-010 (Rev P02) shall be used for Class E(a)(b)(c) or drinking establishment (Sui Generis) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class E of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987(as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) To safeguard the retail character and retail offer of the retail units and to safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval
 
Reason: To safeguard the retail character and retail offer of the retail units and to safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity do not commence without prior approval.
Condition : 4 - Unless previously agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority - and notwithstanding the provisions of Part 3 of Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any subsequent modifications thereto) - no changes of use to any of the land or buildings hereby approved shall take place.
Reason: To safeguard the Council's land use objectives for the site and in the interests of the Development Plan policies and guidance for employment, retail and residential development.

Condition : 5 - Should any of the Commercial, Business and Service (Class E) (excluding Class E(f)) floorspace within Buildings 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 be operated for Class E(a, b or c) use then such uses shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of 07:00 and 23:00 and the Class E(a)(b)(c) or Drinking Establishment (Sui Generis) premises within the single storey retail pods shall not be open to customers other than between the hours of 07:00 and 23:00 Mondays to Saturdays and 07:00 to 22:30 Sundays and Bank Holidays
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the neighbourhood, in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 6 - No amplified speech or sound shall occur in association with the single storey retail pods on drawing CNDL-FLA-ZZ-00-DR-A-05-010 (Rev P02) so as to be audible at the nearest neighbouring residential premises.  
Reason: To prevent any significant disturbance to residents of nearby properties in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 7 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the bat survey approved under details application ref. 2022/3071.  
Reason: In order to prevent harm to protected species in accordance with Council policy LP55 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Landscape Ecological Management Plan approved under details application ref.2023/1181. The development shall not be undertaken otherwise than in accordance with the details approved under this condition.  
Reason: To provide gains for biodiversity in accordance with Council policy LP55 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 9 - Prior to the first occupation of each relevant phase of the development details of a lighting scheme including lux levels and distribution in relation to biodiversity features (including trees) shall be submitted in writing for approval by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be undertaken otherwise than in accordance with the details approved under this condition.  
Reason: To ensure there is no disturbance to wildlife (existing or potential) in accordance with Council policy LP55 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 10 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) prepared by Stantec, dated January 2022 (Project ref. 332510652/100 Rev -) and the following mitigation measures detailed within the FRA: 
 
1.   Residential accommodation finished floor levels are set no lower than 5.54m above Ordnance Datum (AOD) when including a 300mm freeboard allowance. 
 
Reason: To reduce the risk of flooding to the proposed development and future occupants. 
Condition : 11 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details of ground contamination approved as follows: 
 
1) The preliminary risk assessment approved under details application ref.2022/3333 for all Phases of the development.  
 
2) The site investigation scheme approved under details application ref.2022/3333 for all Phases of the development.  
 
3) The remediation strategy approved under details application ref. 2022/3822 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 1-3 and details application ref. 2022/3823 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 4-5. 
 
4) The verification plan approved under details application ref. 2022/3822 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 1-3 and details application ref. 2022/3823 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 4-5. 
 
Any changes to these components require the express consent of the local planning authority. The scheme shall be implemented as approved. 
 
Reason: For the protection of Controlled Waters. The site is located over a Secondary Aquifer and it is possible that the site may be affected by historic contamination. 
Condition : 12 - If, during development, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then no further development (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority) shall be carried out until the developer has submitted, and obtained written approval from the Local Planning Authority for, a remediation strategy detailing how this unsuspected contamination shall be dealt with. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved, verified and reported to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: There is always the potential for unexpected contamination to be identified during development groundworks. We should be consulted should any contamination be identified that could present an unacceptable risk to Controlled Waters 
Condition : 13 - Prior to occupation of the development, a verification report demonstrating completion of the works set out in the approved remediation strategy and the effectiveness of the remediation shall be submitted to and approved, in writing, by the local planning authority. The report shall include results of sampling and monitoring carried out in accordance with the approved verification plan to demonstrate that the site remediation criteria have been met. It shall also include any plan (a "long-term monitoring and maintenance plan") for longer-term monitoring of pollutant linkages, maintenance and arrangements for contingency action, as identified in the verification plan, if appropriate, and for the reporting of this to the local planning authority. Any long-term monitoring and maintenance plan shall be implemented as approved. 
Reason: Should remediation be deemed necessary, the applicant should demonstrate that any remedial measures have been undertaken as agreed and the environmental risks have been satisfactorily managed so that the site is deemed suitable for use 
Condition : 14 - Whilst the principles and installation of sustainable drainage schemes are to be encouraged, no drainage systems for the infiltration of surface water drainage into the ground are permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to Controlled Waters. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approval details. 
Reason: Infiltrating water has the potential to cause remobilisation of contaminants present in shallow soil/made ground which could ultimately cause pollution of groundwater. 
Condition : 15 - Piling or any other foundation designs using penetrative methods shall not be permitted other than with the express written consent of the Local Planning Authority, which may be given for those parts of the site where it has been demonstrated that there is no resultant unacceptable risk to groundwater. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. 
Reason: The developer should be aware of the potential risks associated with the use of piling where contamination is an issue. Piling or other penetrative methods of foundation design on contaminated sites can potentially result in unacceptable risks to underlying groundwaters. We recommend that where soil contamination is present, a risk assessment is carried out in accordance with our guidance 'Piling into Contaminated Sites'. We will not permit piling activities on parts of a site where an unacceptable risk is posed to Controlled Waters. 
Condition : 16 - A) The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) approved under details application ref. 2023/0416 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 1-3 and details application ref. 2022/3528 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 4-5. 
 
B) The development shall be carried out in accordance with the programme of geo/archaeological investigation approved under details application ref. 2023/0416 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 1-3 and details application ref. 2023/0789 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 4-5. 
 
C) The development shall be carried out in accordance with the programme of archaeological mitigation site work approved under details application ref. 2023/1956 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 4-5. 
 
For the other phase(s), dependent upon the results of Part B, no development of other than demolition to existing ground level shall take place within each relevant phase until the applicant (or their heirs and successors in title) has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological mitigation site work in accordance with a Written Scheme of Investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the local planning authority in writing and a report on that evaluation has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing. 
 
D) For each relevant phase under Part C, the applicant (or their heirs and successors in title) shall implement a programme of archaeological mitigation in accordance with a Written Scheme of Investigation. 
 
E) The site investigation and post-investigation assessment will be completed prior to one year post the completion date of the development as defined by the borough building regulation officer, in accordance with the programme set out in the Written Scheme of Investigation approved under Parts (A and C), and the provision for an
Condition : 17 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed design and method statements for all of the ground floor structures, foundations and basements and for any other structures below ground level, including piling (temporary and permanent) approved under details application ref. 2022/3331 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 1-3 and details application ref. 2022/4539 for the Phase of the development that contains Buildings 4-5. 
Reason: To ensure that the Thames Tideway Tunnel is not prejudiced by the proposed development, and that the proposed development is designed and constructed so that it would not be adversely affected by the construction of the Thames Tideway Tunnel, in accordance with the Thames Water Utilities Limited (Thames Tideway Tunnel) Order 2014, the National Policy Statement for Waste Water (February 2012) and Council policy LP52 of the Local Plan (2023). 

Condition : 18 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the Tree Protection Measures approved under details application ref. 2022/3073. Such protection shall be installed and retained as approved throughout the period of works. 
Reason: To safeguard the trees in the interest of the amenity of the area, in accordance with Council policy LP56 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 19 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the landscaping and treatment of parts of the site not covered by buildings approved under details application ref.2025/0967. All planting, seeding or turfing included in the approved details shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development, or in accordance with a programme agreed in writing with the local planning authority.  
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance, in accordance with Council policy LP1 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 20 - Notwithstanding what is shown on the approved drawings, details of screening to the sides of the proposed third floor roof terrace at 110 York Road shall be submitted to the local planning authority for approval.  Those details as may be approved shall be completed before any use of the terrace commences, and retained permanently afterwards. 
Reason: To protect the privacy of neighbours and prevent overlooking in accordance with Council policy LP2 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 21 - Details of proposed boundary treatment shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. Such details as may be approved shall be carried out prior to occupation of the building(s).   
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance and to accord with Council policy LP1 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 22 - The Phase of the development containing Building 4 shall be carried out in accordance with the materials approved under details application ref. 2025/1322.  
 
Prior to commencement of above ground works within each relevant other phase notwithstanding any materials specified in the application, details and samples of the facing building materials and paving materials proposed to be used on all external surfaces of the buildings and external surfaces shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority before any works are commenced. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved materials.  
 
Reason: In order to assess the suitability of the proposed materials, in the interests of the appearance of the locality, in accordance with Council policy LP1 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 23 - The new commercial, business and service (Class E) (excluding Class E(f)) floorspace hereby approved shall achieve an 'Excellent' rating under BREEAM UK new construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) for the Shell/Shell and Core stage and an 'Excellent' rating under BREEAM Refurbishment and Fit-out 2014. Within six months of the commencement of the commercial elements within each relevant phase a BREEAM UK Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) Shell/Shell and Core pre- assessment report shall be submitted by the developer, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate how the commercial elements will achieve an "excellent" rating.  
Within 3 months of first occupation of the commercial elements within each relevant phase, unless otherwise agreed in writing, a BREEAM UK New Construction 2014 (or such equivalent standard that replaces this) Shell/Shell and Core Final (Post- Construction) Certificate, issued by the BRE, must be submitted, by the developer, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that an 'Excellent' rating has been achieved. All the measures integrated shall be retained for as long as the development is in existence. 
 
Reason: To ensure a sustainable development in accordance with Council policy LP10 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 24 - The development shall achieve a maximum water use of 105 litres per person per day (plus 5 litres for outside use) in line with the Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government. Prior to first occupation, evidence to demonstrate that that the internal water consumption of the development will not exceed 105l/p/day must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. Measures integrated shall be retained for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: In the interests of sustainable development in accordance with Council policy LP10 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 25 - The ground floor/mezzanine levels of Building 4 (the 25 storey tower) shall be carried out with the detailed drawings approved under details application ref.2025/1288. Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority the development shall be undertaken and retained in accordance with the details hereby approved. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance at ground/mezzanine level and in the interests of the amenity and access of users of the public realm in accordance with Council policy LP1 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 26 - No water tanks, plant, lift rooms or other structures shall be erected upon the roofs of the approved buildings without the written approval of the local planning authority. 
Reason: To control the appearance of the building(s) and safeguard the appearance of the area, in accordance with Council policy LP1 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 

Condition : 27 - No pipes or flues shall be fixed on the elevations of the buildings hereby approved without the prior written approval of the local planning authority. 
Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the area, in accordance with Council policy LP1 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 28 - The approved development shall comprise 175 residential units (Use Class C3) as shown on the plans hereby approved. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 29 - The  proposed  development  shall  provide  the  following  land  uses  in accordance with the plans hereby approved: 
i.	Commercial, Business and Service - Class E (excluding Class E(f)) 
ii.	Flexible    Commercial/Service/Drinking   Establishment    -    Class E(a)(b)(c)/Sui Generis (excluding Class E(f)) 
iii.	Residential - Class C3 
 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 30 - The approved development shall comprise of 61 car parking spaces and 414 long stay and 60 short-stay cycle parking spaces as shown on the plans hereby approved. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 31 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with phasing plans 14023_C645_P_B1_099; and 14023_C645_P_ZZ_099. The phasing plans may be amended from time to time to reflect changes to the phasing of the development, subject to obtaining prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 32 - No less than 615sqm (GIA) of the Class E (excluding Class E(f)) floorspace across Buildings 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 shall be made available for occupation for office use falling under Class E(g(i) of the Use Classes Order 1987 (as amended) unless a reduced amount of office floorspace within the development is agreed in writing by the local planning authority 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 

Condition : 33 - No more than 4,743sqm (GIA) of the Class E (excluding Class E(f)) floorspace across Buildings 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and the retail pods shall be occupied for retail uses falling under Class E(a)(b)(c) of the Use Classes Order 1987 (as amended) unless agreed in writing by the local planning authority 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.  
Condition : 34 - Prior to the occupation of Building 4, the applicant shall submit to the Local Planning Authority a Flood Management and Evacuation Plan for Building 4 which shall include detail of safe access and egress, who will take responsibility for advising occupants of the Flood Response Plan, ensuring new residents are also informed, updating the Plan and conducting an Annual Review of the Plan and circulating any updated version produced plus registering the EA Flood line. The plans shall include details of monitoring. Subject to the LPA approving the FMEP it shall then be implemented as approved in perpetuity and for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: To safeguard future users from the risk of flooding, in accordance with Council policy LP12 of the Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 35 - The development hereby approved shall achieve a minimum of a 35% reduction in CO2 emissions above the levels set in Building Regulations Part L 2021, with a target of 75.26%, as indicated within approved Energy Strategy Report Hilight - Building 4 ref. CNDL-MKP-04-XX-RP-M-000020-T06 dated 20/05/2025 by MKP. Prior to first occupation of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs, copies of installation contracts and as-built worksheets prepared under SAP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, to demonstrate that the development has achieved at least a 35% reduction in CO2 emissions above the levels set in Building Regulations Part L 2021. The installed measures shall be retained in accordance with the approved details unless otherwise agreed by the local planning authority.  
Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to accord with Council policy LP10 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 36 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
